title: Python: A1 star re-export module attribute (DEC-303 (a22) item 3, (a23) step 4)
description: Admitted group A1: attribute access on a module whose names come from a star re-export. Complete-export-set logic, last binding in module order wins, incomplete set unresolved. Fixtures red before, green after. Held-out samples stay spent; python-gate fenced.
implementationNotes: A1 built (DEC-303 (a22) item 3): resolveStarAttribute in src/python/calls.ts, called from resolveModuleAttribute when no binding of the module carries the name; stars walked in module order, last that can supply the name wins, an incomplete star (unresolved, external, non-literal __all__) leaves it unresolved unless a later complete star exports the name. 11 new fixtures in test/python-calls.test.ts (addition only); 6 positives red without the src change, negatives green both ways. Measurement with markerDirsFor over the five pins: flask, jinja, rich, tqdm unchanged (0 in-package effect); httpx resolvedInRepo 593->1733, nameNotBound 937->54, receiverNeedsInference 1270->1020, resolvedExternal 1389->1382; all 1142 new sites are in tests/, none in the package: the 883 A1 sites plus about 257 knock-on sites where a local bound by httpx.Client(...) is now a known class. A1's in-package value stays unmeasured.

ROUND 1 FIXES (review of 2a40dfa). R1: resolveStarAttribute now consults the holder's module scope (lookupBindings) first; an assign, for, with or except-as binding of the name keeps the call unresolved (rebound). R2: the selected star is resolved through resolveStarBound (rule 33), so a rebinding in the star source is seen, and carries its own visited set and hop bound per call (this also fixes the N1 diamond false negative: the old shared visited set made the second branch read a cycle). Stars are read last to first (rule 45). Fixtures added: holder rebinding x4, source rebinding, diamond, a complete-star cycle with literal __all__ naming an undefined name, and a class base pkg.Base reaching an inherited method; R1, R2 and the diamond are red against the round-1 code. KNOWN GAPS, as for bare names: a def or import in the holder BEFORE the star beats the star though in Python the later one wins (true before this PR); a star import's condition (try/except) is ignored and the last star is picked (same as resolveUnbound). KNOCK-ONS: class bases written pkg.Name now resolve, changing the MRO for inherited and super calls; the eight sites that left the external bin are super().__enter__/__exit__/__aenter__/__aexit__ in tests/client/test_client.py:245,249,277,281 and test_async_client.py:196,200,229,233, where the class base httpx.BaseTransport is now found, so super() reaches httpx/_transports/base.py instead of an external base; the resolvedExternal delta is -7 net, so one site moved the other way and is not identified. Bin deltas on httpx re-measured after the fix, identical: in-repo +1140, nameNotBound -883, receiverNeedsInference -250, resolvedExternal -7 (sums to 0); 1142 distinct sites gained edges, 2 of them already had an edge; the other four repos are unchanged. The earlier modifiedFiles listing of modules.ts and test/python-modules.test.ts was wrong (neither is touched); corrected. A1 in-package value stays unmeasured.

ROUND 2 (review of 8fbf159; supersedes the earlier knock-on accounting where they differ). PER-SITE DIFF, instrumented scratch copies (bin, reason, edge flags polymorphic/multiplyBound/externalBaseBefore logged for every call) at origin/dev 4f..a2e1253 versus this branch, over all five pins with markerDirsFor: flask, jinja, rich, tqdm have ZERO changed sites and unchanged polymorphicCount (15, 171, 3, 53) and multiplyBoundCount. httpx: 1149 changed call entries, 2 in the package, 1147 in tests/. Package: the two package sites httpx/_client.py:937:21 and :1652:21 (auth.sync_auth_flow and auth.async_auth_flow calls, edges to httpx/_auth.py) gained the polymorphic flag only, no bin change; polymorphicCount 4 -> 6, multiplyBoundCount 0 -> 0. Mechanism: test classes written class T(httpx.X) now resolve their base, so buildChildrenMap counts test subclasses as descendants of package classes and hasSubclassOverride flags package call sites. Transitions: name -> inRepo 883; receiver -> inRepo 249; inRepo gained an edge 2 (tests/client/test_auth.py:704:44 and tests/client/test_redirects.py:353:37: constructions of class ConsumeBodyTransport(httpx.MockTransport) gain the inherited MockTransport.__init__ edge, httpx/_transports/mock.py:16:9; confirmed) plus the 2 flag changes above; external -> inRepo 8 (super().__enter__/__exit__ at tests/client/test_client.py:245,249,277,281 reaching BaseTransport.__enter__/__exit__ at httpx/_transports/base.py:15,18, and super().__aenter__/__aexit__ at tests/client/test_async_client.py:196,200,229,233 reaching AsyncBaseTransport at base.py:66,69; the async four ARE AsyncBaseTransport subclasses, so the earlier wording 'BaseTransport' for all eight was wrong for those four); external -> receiver 2 (self.handler(request) at tests/client/test_auth.py:692:16 and tests/client/test_redirects.py:349:16: the base httpx.MockTransport now resolves, handler is an instance attribute, so instance-attribute replaces external-base); receiver -> external 3 (tests/models/test_cookies.py:85:16 cookies.items(), tests/models/test_headers.py:44:5 and :46:5 h.setdefault: httpx.Cookies and httpx.Headers now resolve to in-repo classes whose method is absent and whose base is opaque, so external-base). RECONCILED: external entries removed 10 (8 + 2) minus added 3 = -7 exactly, matching 1389 -> 1382; the earlier -5 came from my counting only the 8, and the call-key dedup (72 duplicate site keys, e.g. super() and super().m() share a position) hid the other two. Everything above is bin and edge level for tests; none of it moves a package bin. CODE: the holder rebinding check now runs only when the holder has a star import, so a plain module with no star keeps attribute-not-found (fixture added; red against the 8fbf159 code, which reported rebound). Fixtures added: a later complete star that does not export the name is skipped; the cycle fixture asserts the import-cycle reason. KNOWN GAPS stated: del name after a star is not modelled (a false edge, as for bare names); a multiply-bound result becomes unresolved rebound where bare names give multiplyBound edges; a cycle ends at the selected star where rule 40 continues to earlier stars (both conservative); a def or import in the holder before the star beats the star (true before this PR); a star import condition (try/except) is ignored. CORRECTION to the round-1 note: the diamond resolves because only the LAST exporting star is read and the function returns early, not because of the per-call context (the context gives the rule-33 resolution its own visited set and hop bound). A1 in-package value stays unmeasured.

CORRECTIONS to the round-2 note, and landing. (1) The baseline written there as 'origin/dev 4f..a2e1253' is the full SHA a2e12535604a8646687a45b8f2f434bccf68c911 (dev before this PR). (2) The per-site measurement was taken at analyzer code dd1c8bb5d834e1c14fe7534d0cbc749b8b790ecb (the post-N1 state; the branch had earlier code states 2a40dfa and 8fbf159, and N1 changes the reason field for no-star holders, so the zero-changed-sites claim with reasons logged is meaningful only on that code). (3) Landed as opum-ai/glyph-cli#147, squash 3dae81e2e4d53cee5360fd42cf899d244a6e0b5e on dev, after Opus APPROVE at dd1c8bb; open design question routed by the leader to opum-doc: whether test-tree subclasses should count toward package polymorphism (the two flagged package sites httpx/_client.py:937:21 and :1652:21).
finalSummary: A1 star re-export module attribute landed in opum-ai/glyph-cli#147 (squash 3dae81e). In-package effect on the five pins: none in bins; two httpx package sites gained the polymorphic flag; A1's in-package value stays unmeasured.
